title.en: Modifying the Rates of Export Duty on Certain Exported Articles as Provided in Ra 1937, as Amended By Pd 230, With Respect to Copper Ore and Concentrate

text.en:
The article specifically listed hereunder as classified under Section 514 of Republic Act 1937 as
amended by P.D. 230 shall pay the following rates of export duty:
Mineral Products
(1) Metallic ores and concentrates

This Order shall take effect on January 1, 1975.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, 1974.
